_comment: Terms that Reckoning of New York uses but the extracted Coteries glossary does
not cover, because they never appear in that game's script. Unlike
official_glossary.json, these are NOT machine-extracted from a shipped official
translation, so each one records where it comes from and how confident we are.
Anything marked 'unverified' is a judgement call worth a human check.

disciplines._source: Italian V5 rules terminology, cross-checked against lokendil.com's V5 rules commentary, which quotes the Discipline names in Italian. Corroborated by official_glossary.json entry 58, 'Blood Sorcerer' -> 'Stregone del Sangue', matching that source's 'Stregoneria del Sangue'.

discipline_powers._source: Italian V5 power names. Ascendente's first level offers Soggezione or Sguardo Terrificante, which map to Awe and Daunt. These appear in dialogue as bracketed choice tags such as [AWE]. Mesmerize, Reveal Temperament, Unseen Passage and Sense the Unseen were confirmed against Italian V5 write-ups of Dominazione, Auspicio and Oscurazione (libercarminii.wikidot.com, valmneira.com).

discipline_powers_unconfirmed._source: No Italian source found that names these powers. Compel follows valmneira.com, which gives Comando for the level-one imperative command of Dominazione, but that page describes the older edition rather than V5. Lingering Kiss has no Italian attestation at all.

sects_and_clans._source: Standard Italian VtM usage. Antidiluviani and Ministero are settled terms; Setita follows the older Seguaci di Set naming.

camarilla._source: Standard Italian VtM usage; not in the Coteries script. Praxis is left untranslated, as Elysium and Masquerade are. Hound follows the Italian V5 Camarilla material, where the Sheriff's enforcers are Segugi. The acronym SAD stays English the way FBI and NSA do, even though the full name is translated on first mention.

clan_nicknames._source: Not in the Coteries script, but the Italian Compendio (the V5 Companion) lists both Ravnos nicknames as Corvi and Canaglie. The game uses the two interchangeably, both linked to the same glossary entry; the Italian keeps them distinct the way the English does. Daredevils and The Haunted, the other two monikers the clan card lists, have no Italian attestation found so far; Spericolati and Braccati are our own renderings and should be checked against the Compendio.

clan_monikers._source: The in-game glossary closes every clan card with a Monikers line, and the Italian V5 corebook has canonical wording for all of them. It could not be reached: worldofdarkness.it does not resolve and the AnyFlip scan of the manual answers 403. Clan dei Re and Sangue Blu are confirmed by Italian secondary sources; everything else here is our own rendering of a transparent common noun or of a proper name, and the whole group needs checking against the manual. Where a moniker is also a nickname used in dialogue, clan_nicknames wins.

traditions._source: The six Camarilla Traditions, confirmed in Italian by vln.fandom.com's Le Tradizioni della Camarilla and by Italian V5 material: La Masquerade, Il Dominio, La Progenie, La Responsabilita, L'Ospitalita, La Distruzione. Vicissitudine is confirmed by cainiti.com and vln.fandom.com. Lotta Eterna and Settimana degli Incubi follow standard Italian VtM usage and are less firmly attested.

setting._source: Not found in the Coteries script or the extracted glossary.
